review_scope: 24 original static storyboard scenes visually checked per channel
visual_review_note: Reviewed all 8 generated scene stills for each of 9 rendered Shorts through contact sheets. Verified coherent subjects, no glaring anatomy issues, and theme consistency. This was not a frame-by-frame video/audio listening review.

publication_rule: Only change privacy of exact existing private YouTube IDs after checked video channel, title, description, processing, audience and authorized edit OAuth scopes. No insert, delete or blind retries.
